questions.question: Discuss survey and interview methods used in tourism research. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Discuss survey and interview methods used in tourism research.
  • The survey method collects data from a large number of respondents using
  • questionnaires, useful for identifying trends and patterns. The interview method
  • involves direct interaction, providing in-depth information about tourist behaviour and
  • experiences. Both methods help understand the social, cultural, and economic impacts
  • of tourism and support effective planning and policy-making.
